blocks.text: DNA ki banawat ki daryaft (1953) aur central dogma ke khayal (1957) ke baad yeh ahem sawalat saamne aaye:

items: DNA, jis mein sirf chaar qisam ke nucleotides hain, hazaron khaas proteins banane ki genetic maloomat kaise rakh sakta hai?
Agar DNA mein maloomat genetic code ki shakal mein hai, to is code ki noeiyat (nature) kya hai?
Agar genetic code DNA mein nucleotides ki tarteeb (order) ki shakal mein hai, to yeh polypeptide mein amino acids ki tarteeb kaise tay karta hai?
